minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  October 24, 2023

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Vice
  Chair Lau at 6:30 p.m.

  Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Wendy Lau, YFAC Vice Chair, Mayor Pro Tem
  Greg Palatto, BUSD Board Member
  Denise Fisher, Resident
  Don Kendrick, Resident

  Dan Harden, Resident
  Jason Prows, LVPD
  Cory Leeper, LVPD
  Eduardo Burgos, LVPD
  Mark Rodgers, BUSD
  Nikole Burgess, BUSD
  JR Ranells, City of La Verne
  Erin Beilstein, City of La Verne
  Emily Turner, Resident
  Jeff Allred, Resident
  Bill Aguirre, Resident
  Ron Serven, Resident
  Nathan Kwan, BHS Student

2. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the September 26, 2023, meeting were
  approved.

3. YFAC History  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells presented the
  history of the Youth & Family Action Committee. He
  shared about the founding mission and programs of
  the committee. Additionally, one of the founding
  YFAC members, Dan Harden shared more about
  how the committee began and grew to what it is
  today.

4. Reed Foundation  Dan Harden shared with the group about the Ruth
  & Joseph Reed Foundation. This foundation
  supports over 50 arts programs for kids at risk
  across California. The Youth and Family Action
  Committee was presenting a check for $17,000 to
  be used to move the mission of the committee
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes October 24, 2023, page 2

  forward by continuing to support La Verne youth.
  Dan noted that YAC should include at least one art
  related program.

5. Program Review  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells talked with the
  group about how YFAC can expand its mission and
  vision through revamped programs. At a previous
  meeting, the committee discussed creating a
  program proposal process for the school district’s
  faculty and staff. City staff will share a draft of that
  grant proposal with the committee.

6. SRO Report  Student Resource Officer (SRO) Eduardo Burgos
  discussed his role in the community and how
  meaningful it is to be in the position. He shared more
  about the explorer program and how it is building
  back up as an alternative way for students to get
  involved in positive programs. Additionally, SRO
  Burgos continues to work on education programs
  surrounding vaping.

7. BUSD Report  Mark Rodgers from BUSD reported that the test
  scores for the district have been released. La Verne
  students have scored ahead of some neighboring
  cities. La Verne scores reflect close to pre-Covid
  performance, which is unusual for most districts.
  They are seeing an improvement in attendance on
  every one of their school campuses which has many
  benefits to the district and students. He also shared
  more about the counseling program. Youth
  Representative Nathan Kwan shared that he thinks
  the programs are very successful and helpful.

8. Public Comment  Jeff Allred shared about how YFAC continues to
  succeed. He also shared an idea about the gym at
  the former Lutheran High School and using it for
  public benefit. Bill Aguirre, former La Verne
  Community Services Director, talked about his time
  with YFAC and the origin of some of its programs.
  Denise Fisher also shared about her Christmas Elf
  program. Every year they’ve been filling the needs
  of over 100 kids, and they’ve already hit that
  number with two schools not yet reporting.

9. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for
  November 28, 2023.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes October 24, 2023, page 3

10. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 7:43 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Erin Beilstein
Management Analyst
